name: session-mesh-browser-assets
description: Pinned, locally built browser assets for Session Mesh.

scripts.check:folder-state: tsc --project tsconfig.folder-state.json && node tools/build-folder-state.mjs --check && node tools/test-folder-state.mjs && node tools/test-session-activity.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/session-activity-idle.test.ts
scripts.check:pane-actions: tsc --project tsconfig.pane-actions.json && node tools/build-pane-actions.mjs --check && node tools/check-pane-actions-contract.mjs && npm run check:shortcuts
scripts.check:shortcuts: tsc --project tsconfig.shortcuts.json && node tools/build-shortcuts.mjs --check && node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/shortcuts.test.ts
scripts.check:workspace-spec: tsc --project tsconfig.workspace-spec.json && node tools/build-workspace-spec.mjs --check && node tools/test-workspace-spec.mjs
scripts.lint:js: eslint eslint.config.mjs static/app.js static/board-src.mjs static/board-fonts.mjs static/sw.js static/mesh-frame-history.js tools
scripts.check:demo-runtime: node demo-runtime/test-boundary-v0.mjs && node demo-runtime/test-boundary-v2.mjs && node demo-runtime/test-admission-record-v1.mjs && node demo-runtime/test-packet-v3.mjs
scripts.check:demo-catalog: tsc --project tsconfig.demo-catalog.json && node tools/build-demo-catalog.mjs --check && node tools/test-demo-catalog.mjs
scripts.check:demo-view: tsc --project tsconfig.demo-view.json && node tools/build-demo-view.mjs --check && node tools/test-demo-view.mjs
scripts.check:demo-input: tsc --project tsconfig.demo-input.json && node tools/build-demo-input.mjs --check && node tools/test-demo-input.mjs && node demo-runtime/test-input-schema-vectors.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint:js && npm run check:terminal-links && npm run check:third-party && npm run check:bridge-quality && npm run check:board && npm run check:demo-runtime && npm run check:demo-catalog && npm run check:demo-view && npm run check:demo-input && npm run check:projects
scripts.check:projects: tsc --project tsconfig.projects.json && node tools/build-projects.mjs --check && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/project*.test.ts
